Callout.Name: Vehicle on the Wrong Side
Callout.Message: Vehicle travelling the wrong way on the freeway.
Callout.Advisory: Multiple callers, headlights on, no collision yet.

Script.Line: It is on the wrong side of the barrier and it is not slowing down.
It has gone past two junctions and nobody is stopping it.
Shut the carriageway. Shut it now.

Lines.Approach: Several callers and it is still going. Get ahead of it if you can.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
